resources.string: Battery for your AirPods and their case
Lets your AirPods show the desktop, Overview and more

When you press an AirPods stem or nod or shake your head, HearOn Link can do system actions you pick: show the desktop, Overview, Back, notifications, Quick Settings, a screenshot or lock the screen. This service only performs those actions. It receives no accessibility events, doesn\'t read the screen, and doesn\'t see what you type or tap.
